'''BFLs''' were labor [[Droid/Legends|droids]] produced by [[Serv-O-Droid, Inc./Legends|Serv-O-Droid, Inc]]. They were similar to the [[BLX labor droid|BLX]] models. [[Baffle]] was a BFL.
